documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Goldiam International reported a strong performance for Q1 FY27, with total income growing 54% year-on-year and PAT more than doubling. The company has successfully transitioned to a major supplier of lab-grown diamond jewellery, which now accounts for over 90% of its export sales. Management highlighted a tariff-agnostic business model achieved through US-based casting operations and confirmed that recent gold customs duty increases will not materially impact profitability. The company maintains a zero net-debt structure and continues to expand its domestic retail brand, ORIGEM. Goldiam International reported record-breaking financial results for FY26, with revenue exceeding INR1,000 crores and significant growth in EBITDA and PAT.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve double-digit revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: We hope for and we are looking forward to build towards a very positive growth, double-digit growth in FY '27 on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: The company targets an exit revenue of INR7 crores per month for the ORIGEM business by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: So we are hoping and targeting an exit revenue of about INR7 crores per month for FY '27 for the ORIGEM business.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for lab-grown diamond jewelry remains robust in the U.S. market.
demand_outlook.quote: With these changes in mind, we see the demand scenario remaining robust.

demand_outlook.claim: Retailers are shifting to lower caratage gold to maintain price points for end customers.
demand_outlook.quote: In general, we see our retailers in order to minimize the advent of higher raw material costs, specifically in gold, moving down in Kt.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is rapidly scaling its ORIGEM retail footprint across India.
capex_expansion.quote: Rapidly scaling ORIGEM retail footprint across key urban clusters

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open 8 to 10 additional ORIGEM stores by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores coming up -- 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores coming up, and they'll be all operational by September 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company aims to have 45 to 50 ORIGEM stores by the end of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: So we may have a quarter where we decide to focus on enhancing revenues from existing stores. But by exit FY '27, the ideal goal is to be in the range of 45 to 50 COCO stores.

capex_expansion.claim: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores in the pipeline, and they will be operational by September 30, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores in the pipeline, and they will be operational by September 30, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: The company's steady-state EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was 24% after accounting for tariff refund calibration.
margins_costs.quote: Steady state EBIDTA margin, post tariff refund calibration, grew by 400 basis points to 24%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the increase in gold customs duty will not have a material impact on the company's financial performance.
margins_costs.quote: The recent increase in Customs Duty on gold to 15%, comprising 10% Basic Customs Duty (BCD) and 5% cess, we would like to inform you that the said increase shall not have any material impact on the operations, financial performance, or profitability of the Company.

margins_costs.claim: The hybrid casting model is expected to provide a 200 to 300 basis point increment in gross margins on a full-year basis.
margins_costs.quote: It's about between 200 to 300 basis point increment that we are expecting on a full year basis.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects margins in FY27 to be higher than those reported in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: We are extremely excited and have strong belief that the margin profile in FY '27 will be significant, strong and certainly higher than the Q4 numbers at the moment.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book as of June 30, 2026, stood at approximately ₹2250 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam’s order book position as on June 30, 2026 was at about ₹ 2250 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book is expected to be fulfilled within three to four months.
orders_capacity.quote: This order book is expected to be executed in next three-four months.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's order book as of March 31, 2026, stood at approximately INR2,000 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam's order book position as on March 31, 2026, was at about INR2,000 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates 30 machines for growing lab-grown diamonds in-house.
orders_capacity.quote: So we have about 30 machines within the facility in SEZ that are operating nonstop.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's order book position as of March 31, 2026, was approximately ₹2,000 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam’s order book position as on March 31, 2026 was at about ₹ 2000 million.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a bonus share issue in the ratio of 1:3.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a bonus share in the ratio 1:3 fully paid up equity shares of INR2 each in proportion of new fully paid up equity share of INR2 for every 3 existing fully paid up equity shares of INR2 each, subject to the approval of shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The cost to open one ORIGEM store is approximately INR3.5 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So all in, if you add these 3 buckets up, the total expense to open an ORIGEM store or cash out to open an ORIGEM store is about INR3.5 crores, give or take a certain amount.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors proposed an issue of bonus shares in the ratio of 1:3.
capital_allocation.quote: Bonus Shares: The board of directors proposed an issue of bonus shares in the ratio of 1:3

risks_headwinds.claim: The company utilizes a US-based casting model to mitigate the impact of US tariffs.
risks_headwinds.quote: In September 2025, in response to the steep hike in US tariffs, through its U.S. subsidiary, Goldiam began casting raw gold into unfinished jewellery pieces within the United States itself, providing employment and job opportunities domestically in the US.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company stated that recent increases in Indian gold custom duties will not materially impact its operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Here, I would like you to note that Goldiam is tariff agnostic and the recent increase in custom duty in India on gold to 15% will not have any material impact on Goldiam's operations, financial performance or profitability.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced business disruptions related to US tariffs and the West Asia war during FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the business disruptions related to tariff and West Asia war; Goldiam ended FY2026 with an impressive 27.5% consolidated revenue increase at ₹ 10212.3 million.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to have 45 to 50 ORIGEM stores operational by the end of the fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: But by exit FY '27, the ideal goal is to be in the range of 45 to 50 COCO stores.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to open 8 to 10 new ORIGEM stores by September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores coming up -- 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores coming up, and they'll be all operational by September 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend INR4 crores to INR4.5 crores on marketing for the first half of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For the first half of fiscal 2027, we are looking forward to spend between INR4 crores to INR4.5 crores in marketing expense.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to make 8 additional ORIGEM stores operational.
management_commitments.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores in the pipeline, and they will be operational by September 30, 2026.
